info.name: Ouvira ERP API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Ouvira ERP backend API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Import `Ouvira_ERP.postman_environment.json`
3. Run **Auth / Login** — access + refresh tokens are auto-saved to environment variables
4. All authenticated requests use `{{access_token}}` automatically

## Environments
- `base_url`: http://localhost:8000 (dev) or https://api.ouvira.com (prod)
- `tenant`: your tenant subdomain

## Auth Flow
Signup → OTP Verify → Finalize Sign-in → Login → (optional 2FA) → use access_token

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
Authentication, OTP, 2FA, and password management.
All endpoints are public (no token required) unless noted.

item.name: 👤 Account
item.description: User profile management. All endpoints require Bearer token.

item.name: 🏢 Company
item.description: Company CRUD and settings. GET is open to authenticated members; PUT/PATCH requires admin; DELETE requires owner.

item.name: 🔑 Access Control
item.description:
Permissions, Roles, Role-Permission assignments, User-Company memberships, and Invitations.
GET endpoints: any authenticated user. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE: admin only.

item.name: 👥 HRIS — Core
item.description:
Employees, Departments, Job Titles, Positions, Locations, Employments, Attendance.
All nested under /api/v1/hris/core/

item.name: 📋 Recruitment
item.description:
Full recruitment pipeline: Hiring Requests → Job Ads → Candidates → Applications → Interviews → Documents → Offers → Onboarding.

Workflow order:
1. Create Hiring Request → Submit → Approve
2. Job Ad is auto-created → Publish
3. Create Candidate → Create Application
4. Move to Interview stage → Schedule Interview → Record Result
5. Upload Documents → Verify
6. Create Offer → Accept (creates Employee in HRIS)
7. Create Onboarding checklist
